title: Stefon Diggs fined $14,926 for jumping on field goal post after first Commanders touchdown; Jahmyr Gibbs fined $23,027 for head-first TD run

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stefon Diggs fined $14,926 for jumping on field goal post after first Commanders touchdown; Jahmyr Gibbs fined $23,027 for head-first TD run
sources.description: Diggs' penalty cost Washington a chance at a 2-point conversion, while Gibbs was not flagged for misuse of helmet during the game.
